BaseURL.title: Base URL
BaseURL.description: Customer's netFORUM Enterprise base URL (e.g., https://customer.netforum.example.com). The connector appends the xWeb SOAP path /xweb/secure/netForumXML.asmx and POSTs a SOAP Authenticate envelope there to obtain the session token.

Username.title: Username
Username.description: netFORUM xWeb API username. Sent as the userName element in the SOAP Authenticate envelope body.

Password.title: Password
Password.description: netFORUM xWeb API password. Sent as the password element in the SOAP Authenticate envelope body — not HTTP Basic — to mint the session token.
